title: Premium-Garment Addition by Regular Price — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
For garments bought at Marlowe & Finch whose regular price is high, Marlowe & Finch Alterations reads a premium-garment addition from the purchase's regular price on its Merchandise Purchases record:

| Regular price on the purchase record | Premium-garment addition |
|---|---|
| 500.00 USD or more | 6.00 USD |
| 250.00 to 499.99 USD | 3.00 USD |
| below 250.00 USD | none |

**Record read.** The regular price recorded on the purchase record named on the ticket — the item's regular price, not the sale price paid. A ticket that names no purchase record has no regular price to read and no addition.

## Band edges, both sides

| Regular price | Addition |
|---|---|
| 249.99 USD | none |
| 250.00 USD | 3.00 USD |
| 499.99 USD | 3.00 USD |
| 500.00 USD | 6.00 USD |

## Hypothetical illustration

A coat with a regular price of 620.00 USD, bought on sale for 410.00 USD: the regular price is 500.00 USD or more, so the addition is 6.00 USD. A blouse with a regular price of 120.00 USD: none.
